categoryAdvice.shoes: Check the seller’s size chart, foot-length guidance and available width information. Decide whether the shoe box matters before estimating parcel dimensions; keeping it can change the space needed for shipping.
categoryAdvice.hoodies-sweaters: Compare chest width, body length and sleeve measurements with a garment you own. Read the listed fabric information and allow for the bulk of several folded hoodies when planning a parcel.
categoryAdvice.t-shirts: Compare chest and length measurements rather than choosing by the letter on the label. Inspect print placement and colour in your own warehouse photos; catalogue images may show a different variant.
categoryAdvice.jackets: Check shoulders, chest and sleeve length, including room for layers. Consider closures and lining, and discuss suitable packing for structured jackets before requesting compression.
categoryAdvice.pants-shorts: Compare waist, rise, inseam and thigh measurements with a pair that fits. Confirm whether the listing is trousers or shorts and whether the selected variant includes a belt or other accessories.
categoryAdvice.headwear: Check the stated head circumference and whether the closure is adjustable. A structured cap may need shape protection; avoid assuming it can be packed like a soft beanie.
categoryAdvice.accessories: Read the listing for dimensions, materials and included pieces. Small accessories can still need protective packaging, especially when a clasp, rigid frame or delicate surface is involved.
categoryAdvice.short-sets: Confirm that the selected offer includes both pieces. Compare top and bottom measurements separately, and check whether one size choice applies to the whole set.
categoryAdvice.electronics: Check the listed model, plug, voltage and included accessories. Batteries and other restricted contents can affect route eligibility; confirm acceptance before purchasing or combining items.
categoryAdvice.other-stuff: Identify the item’s dimensions, material and intended use from the original listing. Check fragile parts and route restrictions individually rather than assuming every miscellaneous item ships in the same way.
categoryAdvice.jersey: Confirm the sport, cut, size chart and any selected name or number. Personalisation can affect return options; check the seller’s terms before paying and review printing in warehouse photos.
